title: Smart Fan selects PECI Agent1 for SYSFAN
description: The routine selects PECI Agent1 for SYSFAN. Live reads on 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-13 show only Agent0 alive (bank 7, 1F=01). The hidden SYSFAN mode defaults to Full On and all seven saved records have Full On, which limits present relevance.
remediation: Validate agent presence, the source/header relationship and the automatic mode before a one-byte Agent0 substitution. No candidate, C2.
